# Task lists

## Inherited markers preserve their authored scalar

```````````````````````````````` example
- [ ] open
- [x] done
- [X] also done
.
Document scope=1:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=3
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:7..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="open" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=2:7..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=2:7..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="done" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} marker="X" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=3:7..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="also done" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Only an initial marker is structural

```````````````````````````````` example
- a [x] b
- [x]none
.
Document scope=1:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:3..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a [x] b" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=2:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=2:3..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[x]none" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
- [x]→
outside
.
Document scope=1:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── List scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=2:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="outside" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
1. [x] a
   - [ ] b
.
Document scope=1:1..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=1 variant=decimal delimiter=period tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=1:1..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=2
        ├── Paragraph scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        │   └── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
        └── List scope=2:4..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
            └── ListItem scope=2:4..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
                └── Paragraph scope=2:10..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                    └── Text scope=2:10..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

.

└── Callout scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── List scope=1:3..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1

```````````````````````````````` example

- [-] b
- [✓] c
.
Document scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=3
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} marker="?" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} marker="-" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0

        └── Paragraph scope=3:9..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1

            └── Text scope=2:3..2:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[ab] b" children=0

## Every UTF-8 width and authored punctuation

```````````````````````````````` example
- [é] two
- [🚀] four
- [́] combining scalar
- [[] open bracket
- []] close bracket
- [\] backslash
- [→] tab marker
- [] vertical tab marker
- [] form feed marker
.
Document scope=1:1..9:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..9:22 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=9
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} marker="é" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:8..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:8..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="two" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker="🚀" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=2:10..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=2:10..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="four" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=3:1..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} marker="́" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=3:8..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=3:8..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="combining scalar" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=4:1..4:18 anchor=null attributes={} marker="[" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=4:7..4:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=4:7..4:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="open bracket" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=5:1..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} marker="]" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=5:7..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=5:7..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="close bracket" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=6:1..6:15 anchor=null attributes={} marker="\\" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=6:7..6:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=6:7..6:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="backslash" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=7:1..7:16 anchor=null attributes={} marker="\t" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=7:7..7:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=7:7..7:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="tab marker" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=8:1..8:25 anchor=null attributes={} marker="\u000b" children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=8:7..8:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=8:7..8:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="vertical tab marker" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=9:1..9:22 anchor=null attributes={} marker="\f" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=9:7..9:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=9:7..9:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="form feed marker" children=0
````````````````````````````````

    ├── ListItem scope=4:1..4:10 anchor=null attributes={} marker="-" children=1

## Malformed prefixes preserve their text

```````````````````````````````` example
- [🚀]
- [✓]none
- [?] nbsp
- [é] decomposed
- [👩‍💻] joined
- [éé] pair
- [\?] escape
- [&#x2713;] entity
- [? no close
- [?]again
.
Document scope=1:1..10:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..10:10 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=10
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:3..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[🚀]" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[✓]none" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=3:1..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=3:3..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[?] nbsp" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=4:1..4:18 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=4:3..4:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=4:3..4:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[é] decomposed" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=5:1..5:22 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=5:3..5:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=5:3..5:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[👩‍💻] joined" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=6:1..6:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=6:3..6:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=6:3..6:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[éé] pair" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=7:1..7:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=7:3..7:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=7:3..7:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[?] escape" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=8:1..8:19 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=8:3..8:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=8:3..8:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[✓] entity" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=9:1..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=9:3..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=9:3..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[? no close" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=10:1..10:10 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=10:3..10:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=10:3..10:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[?]again" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Nested ordered and bullet items under a callout

```````````````````````````````` example
> 1. [🚀] outer
>    - [?] middle
>      2) [✓] inner
>         continuation
.
Document scope=1:1..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── List scope=1:3..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=ordered start=1 variant=decimal delimiter=period tight=true children=1
        └── ListItem scope=1:3..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} marker="🚀" children=2
            ├── Paragraph scope=1:13..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            │   └── Text scope=1:13..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="outer" children=0
            └── List scope=2:6..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
                └── ListItem scope=2:6..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} marker="?" children=1
                    └── Paragraph scope=2:12..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
                        ├── Text scope=2:12..2:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="middle" children=0
                        ├── SoftBreak scope=2:18..2:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
                        ├── Text scope=3:8..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="2) [✓] inner" children=0
                        ├── SoftBreak scope=3:22..3:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
                        └── Text scope=4:11..4:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal="continuation" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Only the opening prefix is inspected

  [x] later paragraph
- ordinary

  [?] later paragraph
-
  [x] later first block
.

└── List scope=1:1..8:23 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=false children=3

    │   ├── Paragraph scope=1:9..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1

    │   └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=3:3..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[x] later paragraph" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=4:1..6:21 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=2
    │   ├── Paragraph scope=4:3..4:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1

## The prefix precedes the first block decision

```````````````````````````````` example
- [?] # heading
- [✓] > quote
- [🚀] - [?] nested item
- [-] ```text
  code
  ```
- [?] $$
  formula
  $$
- [✓] :::note
  body
  :::
.
Document scope=1:1..12:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..12:5 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=6
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} marker="?" children=1
    │   └── Heading scope=1:7..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} level=1 children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:9..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="heading" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} marker="✓" children=1
    │   └── Callout scope=2:9..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    │       └── Paragraph scope=2:11..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │           └── Text scope=2:11..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="quote" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=3:1..3:26 anchor=null attributes={} marker="🚀" children=1
    │   └── List scope=3:10..3:26 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    │       └── ListItem scope=3:10..3:26 anchor=null attributes={} marker="?" children=1
    │           └── Paragraph scope=3:16..3:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │               └── Text scope=3:16..3:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="nested item" children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=4:1..6:5 anchor=null attributes={} marker="-" children=1
    │   └── CodeBlock scope=4:7..6:5 anchor=null attributes={} info="text" language="text" literal="code\n" fenced=true closed=true children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=7:1..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} marker="?" children=1
    │   └── FormulaBlock scope=7:7..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="formula" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=10:1..12:5 anchor=null attributes={} marker="✓" children=1

                └── Text scope=11:3..11:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0

## Every separator-only opening leaves no paragraph for lazy continuation

```````````````````````````````` example
- [?] →
outside
.
Document scope=1:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── List scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} marker="?" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=2:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="outside" children=0

## Opaque bodies cannot supply a task prefix

```````````````````````````````` example
- `- [?] code`
- $- [✓] formula$
- <i title="- [🚀] html">text</i>
- [[- [?] link]]
- %% - [✓] inline comment %%

%%
- [?] block comment
%%

```
- [🚀] fenced
```
.
Document scope=1:1..13:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── List scope=1:1..6:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=5
│   ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Code scope=1:3..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="- [?] code" children=0
│   ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:19 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Formula scope=2:3..2:19 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="- [✓] formula" children=0
│   ├── ListItem scope=3:1..3:35 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:35 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   │       ├── HTML scope=3:3..3:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<i title=\"- [🚀] html\">" children=0
│   │       ├── Text scope=3:28..3:31 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
│   │       └── HTML scope=3:32..3:35 anchor=null attributes={} literal="</i>" children=0
│   ├── ListItem scope=4:1..4:16 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=4:3..4:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=4:3..4:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[[- [?] link]]" children=0
│   └── ListItem scope=5:1..6:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=5:3..5:30 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Comment scope=5:3..5:30 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" - [✓] inline comment " children=0
├── Comment scope=7:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="- [?] block comment\n" children=0
└── CodeBlock scope=11:1..13:3 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="- [🚀] fenced\n" fenced=true closed=true children=0
````````````````````````````````

## A line ending cannot separate the task marker from lazy content

```````````````````````````````` example
- [x]
:n{class="a b cvf" .a class=tail}a}*.foo.*
:x{:_a}
.
Document scope=1:1..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=1:1..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=1:3..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=8
            ├── Text scope=1:3..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[x]" children=0
            ├── SoftBreak scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
            ├── Directive scope=2:1..2:38 anchor=null attributes={.a .b .c .v .f .a .tail} name="n" children=0
            ├── Text scope=2:39..2:40 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a}" children=0
            ├── Emphasis scope=2:41..2:47 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            │   └── Text scope=2:42..2:46 anchor=null attributes={} literal=".foo." children=0
            ├── SoftBreak scope=2:48..2:48 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
            ├── Directive scope=3:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} name="x" children=0
            └── Text scope=3:3..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="{:_a}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## UTF-8 marker widths preserve nested tab indentation and byte scopes

```````````````````````````````` example
- [?] - →child
- [é] - →child
- [✓] - →child
- [🚀] - →child
.
Document scope=1:1..4:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..4:17 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=4
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} marker="?" children=1
    │   └── List scope=1:7..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    │       └── ListItem scope=1:7..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │           └── CodeBlock scope=1:10..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="child\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=2:1..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} marker="é" children=1
    │   └── List scope=2:8..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    │       └── ListItem scope=2:8..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │           └── CodeBlock scope=2:11..2:15 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="child\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0
    ├── ListItem scope=3:1..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} marker="✓" children=1
    │   └── List scope=3:9..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    │       └── ListItem scope=3:9..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
    │           └── CodeBlock scope=3:12..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="child\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0
    └── ListItem scope=4:1..4:17 anchor=null attributes={} marker="🚀" children=1
        └── List scope=4:10..4:17 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
            └── ListItem scope=4:10..4:17 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
                └── CodeBlock scope=4:13..4:17 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="child\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0
